column1: # WYSIWYG `:Special Copy` — copy formatting (and only formatting)
# Lay down a labelled, bold cell at A1 and a plain labelled cell at B1.
# Both cells already carry content; :Special should copy the *style*
# from A1 to B1 without disturbing either cell's text.
# `:Special Copy` — :S descends, C selects Copy, then POINT for FROM.
# A1 is the FROM range (pointer is parked there from HOME).
# B1 should now carry Bold; A1 keeps Bold; both texts intact.
# `:Special Copy` from a plain cell over a styled one strips the style.
# Pointer is at B1 (post-copy); RIGHT to C1 (plain), then :SC source=C1
# transition_point parks pointer at source TL (C1); LEFT navigates to B1.
